description.zh: 返回的会话数量，如不填写默认返回 20条。
description.en: The number of sessions to return. Default value: 20.
The function alias or version information.

description.zh: 过滤的SessionId值，如指定，可返回此会话关联的所有 Active/Expired 状态信息。
description.en: The session ID to filter by. If specified, all Active or Expired status information associated with this session is returned.

description.zh: 需要过滤的会话状态，默认返回所有Active/Expired状态的会话信息，也可指定 Active 仅获取活跃的会话信息，或指定Expired仅获取过期的会话信息。
description.en: The session status to filter by. By default, all session information in Active or Expired status is returned. Set this parameter to Active to retrieve only active session information, or to Expired to retrieve only expired session information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc list-sessions --function-name my-func --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --next-token MTIzNCNhYmM= --session-status Active --session-id test-session-id-1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc GET /2023-03-30/functions/my-func/sessions --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 'MTIzNCNhYmM=' --qualifier aliasName1 --limit 10 --sessionStatus Active --sessionId 'test-session-id-1' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
